mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(size_bytes), 0) FROM im_file WHERE status = 0

SELECT f.* FROM im_file f WHERE f.status = 0 AND f.deleted_at IS NULL AND f.conversation_id IS NULL AND f.created_at < #{threshold} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM im_moment_media mm JOIN im_moment m ON m.id = mm.moment_id WHERE mm.file_id = f.id AND m.deleted_at IS NULL ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM im_favorite fav WHERE fav.file_id = f.id ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM im_user u WHERE u.avatar LIKE CONCAT('%', f.id, '%') ) ORDER BY f.id LIMIT #{limit}
